agent_explanation: Noisy angle/rate feedback (sensor_noise ~0.012) corrupts state-feedback control: controller applies large erroneous forces (23N at step30, 35N at step32, 54N at step34, 63N at step35) that pump energy instead of damping, so theta grows monotonically 0.68->0.755->0.799->0.807 rad and violates pole_upright. With noise removed the same plant/initial conditions stay balanced, proving noise-induced destabilization is the cause.
